description: Analyze any public onchain wallet and return its Signo Score plus prioritized findings. Covers yield left on the table, leverage safety, LP health, idle capital, dust and unclaimed rewards. Read-only: it inspects public chain data and never moves funds, needs no keys, and requires no connected session — so it works on any address you can name, not just one the caller controls. Returns signoScore (0-100, the Signo Score: how well the wallet's capital is managed, from idle cash, yield against the cash benchmark, unclaimed rewards, the leverage guard and dust; it is not a safety or liquidation-risk score). This public tool cannot read the owner's private Agents, so watch coverage is not_applicable with 'Agent coverage isn't shown here' and signoScore omits that category; the signed-in owner's app score can differ. riskTolerance, walletAge, holdings (every chain's tokens, DeFi positions and loans with USD values, largest first, so you can structure your own view), and a categories array where each entry carries state, headline, detail and a suggested next step. Findings that call for an agent carry agentSuggestion, and the report carries suggestedAgents plus draftWith: exact request and autonomy arguments for the sibling signo_draft_agent tool on this host, so you can draft the agent for the wallet owner to activate. Free.

address.description: The wallet to analyze — an EVM address (0x + 40 hex) or a Solana base58 address.

narrative.description: Include a written plain-English summary alongside the structured findings. Slower; defaults to false.
